[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested tips for improving tackling technique:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Focus on proper body positioning: maintain a low and balanced body position, keep head up and eyes on the ball carrier.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Use proper tackling technique: use shoulder to make contact with the ball carrier's midsection and wrap arms around the opponent's midsection and legs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Start slowly: gradually build up tackling speed and intensity to avoid injuries.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Use tackling bags or pads: simulate resistance and force of an opposing player to practice technique safely.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Work on strengthening exercises: strengthen leg, hip, and core muscles to improve tackling technique and reduce injury risk.
